dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Exploring this domain is no easy task, but please don't worry — I won't let everyone down!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: The Grand Master once told me that so long as I play to my strengths and contribute to the team, I'm doing my duty.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: I'll do my best. And I'm sure everyone else will do their part, too!
